source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 19 April 1991, p. 45 ("Three in poll battle (nominations; poll May 15; vacancy from death of Cllr Andrew Blair in February)"); News Letter, 15 May 1991, p. 9 ("Carrick goes to the polls (three-way contest, today)"); Belfast Telegraph, 16 May 1991, p. 6 ("Hilditch elected to Carrick seat")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph / News Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: No vote figures found in BT, News Letter or Irish News (INA) or BT (BNA). Count sequence only: Hamilton eliminated, Hilditch elected on count 2, McCann runner-up.

note: By-election of 15 May 1991 for one seat in Carrick Castle (Carrickfergus), caused by the death of Councillor Andrew Blair in February 1991 (BNL calls him Independent; elected DUP in 1989 per Civgraph/ARK). The reports found give the result but not every candidate's votes, so no figures are shown.

countGroup.Party_Basis: Printed 'Agreed Unionist' (the unionist parties' agreed candidate); Elliott & Flackes (1999), p. 282, lists him as a DUP member of Carrickfergus council from 1991
